person.name: MAHARAJ KHAN MUNA
person.intro: A Geographer stands with the proud geographer icon 'Bijoypur white clay hill' of her place or origin, Netrokona, Bangladesh.

news.text: Presented a poster at CSBS Research Day at the UofU on the use of machine learning and the NASA SWOT dataset to understand the water level in the Great Salt Lake Basin.
news.label: Poster Link

news.text: Started PhD in Geography at the University of Utah - School of Environment, Society and Sustainability. There, he will be working as a Graduate Research Assistant at the Earth and Water Observation and Sensing (EWOS) lab with Dr Sonam Sherpa.

Joined Auburn University as an Instructor to conduct science labs for undergraduates. Also, jointly appointed by the Citizen Science GIS lab at the Department of Geosciences as a GIS Technician to work on geospatial projects.
Graduated with an MS in Geography and Environmental Studies and a Graduate Certificate in GIS from Auburn University, Department of Geosciences.
Attended the Esri User Conference in San Diego, CA as a student assistant.

education.role: MS in Geography and Environmental Studies
education.details: Thesis: Urbanization and Heat Island Effect in South Asia. Certificate in Geographic Information Systems (GIS).

experience.details: Conducted science labs and worked on geospatial projects.
Delivered lectures, conducted labs, graded exams, mentored students, collected field data, and created maps.
